mapper.select: SELECT u.handle AS row_id, u.handle AS other_handle, u.nickname AS other_nm, u.profile_file_id AS other_file_id, lm.content AS last_content, TO_CHAR(lm.reg_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS last_dt, sub.unread_cnt, CASE WHEN lm.sender_id = #{myId} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS last_mine FROM ( SELECT other_id, MAX(message_id) AS last_id, SUM(CASE WHEN receiver_id = #{myId} AND read_yn = 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unread_cnt FROM ( SELECT message_id, receiver_id, read_yn, CASE WHEN sender_id = #{myId} THEN receiver_id ELSE sender_id END AS other_id FROM t_message WHERE (sender_id = #{myId} AND del_sender = 'N') OR (receiver_id = #{myId} AND del_receiver = 'N') ) x GROUP BY other_id ) sub JOIN t_message lm ON lm.message_id = sub.last_id LEFT JOIN t_user u ON u.user_id = sub.other_id ORDER BY sub.last_id DESC

SELECT m.message_id::TEXT AS row_id, m.content, m.read_yn, TO_CHAR(m.reg_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS reg_dt, CASE WHEN m.sender_id = #{myId} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS mine FROM t_message m WHERE ((m.sender_id = #{myId} AND m.receiver_id = #{otherId} AND m.del_sender = 'N') OR (m.sender_id = #{otherId} AND m.receiver_id = #{myId} AND m.del_receiver = 'N')) ORDER BY m.message_id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE t_message SET read_yn = 'Y' WHERE receiver_id = #{myId} AND sender_id = #{otherId} AND read_yn = 'N'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_message WHERE receiver_id = #{myId} AND read_yn = 'N' AND del_receiver = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_message (sender_id, receiver_id, content, read_yn, del_sender, del_receiver, reg_dt, reg_ip) VALUES (#{senderId}, #{receiverId}, #{content}, 'N', 'N', 'N', NOW(), #{regIp})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_message SET del_sender = CASE WHEN sender_id = #{myId} THEN 'Y' ELSE del_sender END, del_receiver = CASE WHEN receiver_id = #{myId} THEN 'Y' ELSE del_receiver END WHERE (sender_id = #{myId} AND receiver_id = #{otherId}) OR (sender_id = #{otherId} AND receiver_id = #{myId})
